prompt: Нарисовано владельцем в генераторе картинок по промпту из assets/PROMPTS.md, затем обработано локально (нарезка, вырезание фона, WebP). Промпт: Pixel art sprite sheet, 4 columns by 3 rows, twelve equal cells, landscape 4:3. Row 1: chibi young man, short brown hair with a swept-up quiff, blue t-shirt, dark blue jeans, white sneakers. Row 2: chibi young man, dark buzz cut, navy button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, gray trousers, white sneakers. Rows 1 and 2, left to right: standing relaxed, smiling; flexing both biceps; hunched and coughing, gray smoke cloud by his head; asleep standing, tiny z above his head. Style: 8-bit NES sprites, 32x32 pixel grid, crisp square pixels, 1-pixel near-black outline, flat colors, no gradients, no shadows. Background: solid flat magenta #ff00ff. No text, no frame, no grid lines. Front view, full body, sprites centered in cells.
